lines.text: Please let me know if you need any intel.
I'm a bit busy right now. Could you come back a little later?
Many people are wary of us, likely because of the work we do. It's all part of the job, I suppose.
If you want to know anything related to Anis, feel free to call me. I have a bevy of information.
I edited some of the footage I took of you during the last mission, and it turned out quite well. Would you like to see it?
Gaining an inspection unit's trust is a truly remarkable feat. Which is to say, I trust you, Person of Interest.
May I leave now? I have several places I need to investigate.
Take your time. I'll be here editing Anis's concert footage.
The Outpost is remarkably clean, no doubt thanks to your leadership.
I thought I just saw Anis...!
I like reading books in the library, as well as editing videos at home.
Hello. I'm Avistar from the inspection unit Overseer.
Now I can conduct inspections more thoroughly.
I feel like I can really chip in now.
So this is what it feels like... I learned something new.
Is this for me? ... You didn't get it through any illicit channels, did you?
If possible, I would prefer some Anis-related merchandise.
Thank you. I'll make good use of it.
You're a really good person. I'm always grateful for all you do.
My heart is beating fast, just like when I see Anis.
I've never met someone as upright and unsullied as you. Being near you puts my mind at ease.
Combat isn't exactly my forte...
Yes?
Moving.
I'll do my best.
Anis, I need your strength!
I should be able to handle this...
I have the perfect plan.
I just need a little break.
Reloading.
J-just a moment.
I'll handle this.
N-no peeking! You'll distract me!
Concentrate your fire!
Got one.
Who's next?
Nice!
Agh!
Ouch!
Urgh...
Looks like I still have a long way to go...
I think I managed to pull my weight.
